subject: Science
description: Parts of a flower: petals, sepals, stamens, pistil, stem
alt: A flower cut in half lengthwise showing petals, sepals, stamens with anthers, and the pistil with stigma, style and ovary
prompt: A flower in longitudinal section, upright, with a short stem. Several identical petals in blue and teal, green-teal sepals below them, five to six identical stamens (thin filament with an anther) around the centre, and the central pistil (stigma, style, ovary) drawn in the orange accent.
checklist: petals all drawn identically and arranged symmetrically
sepals are below the petals, stamens inside the petals, pistil in the centre
the pistil has a stigma on top, a style and a swollen ovary at the base
stamens are identical to each other
